    // (sqrt x)' = x' / (2 * sqrt x). Precondition: Value is strictly positive
    // (the rule divides by the root, so zero is excluded even though the
    // square root itself is defined there).
    Sqrt(x: DualNumber): DualNumber
        => (x.Value.Sqrt, x.Derivative / (2.0 * x.Value.Sqrt));
